summary: CATHAY GENERAL BANCORP filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026, announcing a new $150 million share repurchase program adopted by its board. The program allows open-market or private repurchases at management's discretion, potentially via a Rule 10b5-1 plan, with no fixed expiration. With ~67 million shares outstanding, the authorization represents ~$2.24/share. The board may suspend or modify the program at any time. What to watch: actual execution pace and any impact on capital ratios or EPS; risk-arb: none, as no M&A catalyst is present.
